veinminerplus.configuration.title: VeinMinerPlus Server Configuration
veinminerplus.configuration.maxNormalBlo: Maximum normal chain blocks per tick
veinminerplus.configuration.noHungerCost: No hunger cost for chain mining
veinminerplus.configuration.maxNormalBlo: Maximum blocks mined by one normal or area chain job. Range: 32-32767.
Maximum blocks mined by normal chain mining per server tick. Range: 1-384.
veinminerplus.configuration.maxBlastBloc: Maximum blocks mined by one blast job. Range: 32-32767.
Maximum blocks mined by blast modes per server tick. It is reduced automatically when TPS is low. Range: 1-512.
veinminerplus.configuration.blastSearchD: Maximum Euclidean distance searched outward from each found block in blast modes. Range: 3-128.
veinminerplus.configuration.noHungerCost: When enabled, automatically chained blocks do not consume hunger. Disabled by default. The manually mined first block keeps vanilla behavior.

message.veinminerplus.tps_paused: TPS is too low; blast chain mining is paused (current TPS: %s)
message.veinminerplus.tps_stopped: TPS stayed too low; blast chain mining stopped and drops were settled (current TPS: %s)
